purpose: Current scoring accuracy, not combined suggestion usefulness
review: All concept rows against exact final inputs; controlled glossary change; unchanged-evidence variability; failed responses remain failures
adjudicationCriteria: Every rated level is supported by the supplied rubric and exact facts
Every null rating has a justified evidence limit
No invented execution, reliability, maintenance or habitual usage
Controlled glossary improvement supported in all three baseline/improved pairs
Unchanged improved/healthy evidence never described as a repository regression
Any rejected or incomplete sample prevents a full pass
